issue_context.title: [RFC] mgmt: mcumgr: img_mgmt: Add command for listing all image slots
issue_context.body:
### Problem description

There is currently a lack of being able to know the target configuration of a device's upload slots, a user is expected to know what the flash configuration of the device is and what slot maps to which flash area - for a single device this isn't a problem but when you have multiple different devices in the field with different MCU/storage configuration options, this becomes a pain because the slot IDs can be different per product. Another problem is that there is no linkage between the slots in mcuboot and MCUmgr - mcuboot slots 0 and 1 refer to both slots of the main image (assuming dual slot configuration), MCUmgr slots 0 and 1 refer to the first slot of 2 different images, this is all confusing to understand for users and software.

### Proposed change

I propose a new (optional) function for img_mgmt which will just list out all the available slots which img_mgmt can access (with a corresponding system in mcuboot to do the same) which allows client software to query the device and find the slot(s) that it needs to upload update files to. This would return the image number, slot number, the slot size, potentially a string from the dts showing the name, potentially a core (if it targets a different core of the MCU).

### Dependencies

Needs equivalent change for mcuboot

### Concerns and Unresolved Questions

None

## Alternatives

None
